narrative.rotation_signal: Rotation into staples (KO, PEP, PG), payments (V, MA), and mega-cap tech (AAPL, AMZN, META, CSCO) — while semis cap-ex (KLAC, MU, INTC), big-box retail (HD, COST), and select financials (GS, C, AXP) are being distributed. Money center banks are splitting with MS bought and GS/C sold.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: Semis divergence is notable — TXN prints a perfect 10.0 while KLAC/MU/INTC sit at the bottom, suggesting rotation within the group rather than sector-wide flow. Financials also split (MS bullish vs GS/C/AXP bearish), which may conflict with a cleaner sector-level read.
